ablation.proxyNotes: video_model_v0's original two features (pull_cost, desirability) cannot be reconstructed from available data (PRD/CollectFolio-Price-Intelligence-PRD.md, Executive decision section: video_model_v0's surviving workbook has hidden/manual desirability inputs and only 22 observations with no out-of-sample validation, so desirability specifically is not recoverable, and this pipeline separately has no per-product pack-odds/EV data for a genuine pull_cost). Substituted here, both proxies research-only: pull-cost proxy = structural_scarcity_proxy(group_variant_count) = -log(group_variant_count), monotonic in the same scarcer-is-costlier direction as the original dollar pull_cost but not on the same scale; desirability proxy = release_age_weeks at asOf, an approximate, non-genuine substitute. Coefficients are freshly fit on this panel via the same ridge-OLS machinery as the main hedonic model, not video_model_v0's literal legacy coefficients.
